perks.name: Augmented Armaments
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
perks.exact:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 15% increased damage against Disoriented Combatants.
Disorient Duration is shorter than the animation, generally lasting for ~2.7 seconds.
Does NOT work with Arc Blind.

perks.name: Augmented Explosives
perks.description: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
perks.exact:
On Grenade Ability Detonation: 
Disorients enemies within 10 meters for 2.7 seconds.
Does not work on Grapple. 
Does not work on Young Ahamkara Spine's Tripmines.
